there was a bear who had a very bad day. He was so sad, he started to cry. He wanted to be a happy bear again, but he didn't know what to do.
He went for a walk, hoping someone would help him find a way to find him. But he couldn't find any. He tried to think of what to do when he came to a lake. But he didn't know how.
He saw a big rock with a fish swimming in it. He thought it might help him get back to the lake. He found a stick and used it to scoop up the frog. But it was too late, the lake was too deep. He couldn't get to the bottom of the lake.
The brave man was sad and he knew he couldn't get back home. He was so tired he had to sit still until he couldn't go home. He never felt the same way.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her soft toy drum. She would play it all day long, making happy songs and dancing.
One day, while Lucy was playing her drum, her friend Tom came over. Tom said, "Lucy, let's play a quiet game. It's not fun. If I tell you something, you will feel bad." But Lucy didn't listen to Tom's warning.
Lucy played her drum at the park, and she made a lot of noise. But then, something bad happened. A big wind came and blew Lucy's drum away! Lucy saw this and knew she had to go. She ran to find Tom and said, "Don't worry, Tom. I will help you find your drum."
So, Lucy and Tom searched the town together. They found the drum under a big tree. Lucy was so happy to have her drum back. She said, "Thank you, Tom! You are a good friend."
From that day on, Lucy and Tom played together every day. They were the best of friends, and everyone in the village knew that her drum was the best toy ever.
